text_block_list.text:
There's been so much to think about
lately when
it comes to training. I feel
like my head is going
to explode.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh dear, you look exhausted!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
There, there, Trainer. I know you've
been working
hard.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
After all this effort, I think you deserve a
treat.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Nope, there's no way around it—you're
getting
that treat.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Even if you were only working hard for
your own
sake, the fruits of your labor
still trickle down to
me.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It only makes sense for me to pay you
back
somehow.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Let me know if there's anything you
want, okay?
Perhaps a tasty meal? Or a
shoulder massage?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Maybe something to clear my head...

text_block_list.text: Your head...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
In that case, I've got just the thing! Sit
tight. I just
need to make a call.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
After making a phone call, Супер Крик
leads me
away.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Heya! Over here, Creek!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Maruzen! Sorry to keep you waiting!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks for calling! Shall we get to
it?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
We're going to the most wonderful
place. Right,
Maruzen? ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Exactamundo. You're gonna have the
best time
ever! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: A bit later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's time for the real deal! Hold on tight,
you two!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! You're really drifting
around these
corners. Isn't this exciting,
Тренер? ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
We're at a racing circuit. The squeal of
tires fills
my ears as the wind pulls back
the skin on my
face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I can barely keep my eyes open as
Марузенски
careens around the track in
her beloved car. My
mind goes
completely blank.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ahh, that felt incredible! I haven't had
such a
radical time in so long!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
How'd you like that speed? Bet your
head's clear
now, huh?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Maruzen's given me a ride in her car
before.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It felt so amazing that I figured you'd
like it too,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: What did you think?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: You've got a stronger stomach than I have.

Well, her driving is nothing to sneeze at, I'll tell
you that...

text_block_list.text: What did you think?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: You've got a stronger stomach than I have.

Well, her driving is nothing to sneeze at, I'll tell
you that...

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, did you feel it in your guts?
You're all
psyched up now, huh?! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful! It makes organizing
this all
worthwhile.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Thank you for your help, Maruzen.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It's all good! I could do this every day. In
fact,
wanna go for another spin?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Goodness! Really?!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Well, if you're offering, then I'll
happily
accept. ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Aww, you'll make me blush with
compliments like
that! Cut it out already!
But seriously, thanks!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Isn't that nice, Maruzen? Thank you so
much!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it. In fact, I'm always
down for
doing stuff like this!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
It's been way too long since I last put
the pedal to
the metal! Wowzers, it felt
amazing! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
You were seriously impressive. How on
earth did
you learn to drive like that?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I suppose I just have a knack for
it.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Exhausted beyond belief, I listen to
Марузенски
and Супер Крик chat away.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Although I politely decline, they're
feeling too
"psyched up" to actually hear
me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
At least, it looks like Супер Крик has
learned
something from Марузенски's
fierce driving.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
